_comment: Checked-in dictation bias list: the vocabulary everyone on this team needs,
regardless of what they happen to have dictated before.
The mined asset (dictation_vocabulary.json, gitignored, one per machine) only
knows terms a given person has already used - so a fresh clone, a new
teammate, or a term someone has only ever typed gets no bias at all. This file
covers that floor. It is merged ahead of the mined terms at load time.
Keep it short and high-signal: contextualStrings is a bias list, not a
dictionary, and Apple's accuracy degrades when it is flooded. Add a term only
if the recogniser actually gets it wrong - a word it already handles wastes a
slot and makes that word more likely everywhere.
